items.question: By what means do the cakras reveal their own nature?
premises: The cakras possess an own nature.
This nature can be revealed in various ways.
Knots, bases, phases, and related means serve as instruments of revelation.
items.inference: The cakras disclose their own nature through diverse means such as knots, bases, and phases.
items.plain_english: In whatever way, through knots, bases, phases, and so forth, the cakras reveal their own nature.

items.question: Who endowed with knowledge fails to teach this own nature openly?
premises: The own nature can be taught openly.
Some teachers do teach it aloud.
Possession of knowledge implies the capacity to teach.
items.inference: All who are endowed with knowledge teach this own nature openly.
items.plain_english: They too teach the own nature aloud; who endowed with knowledge would not?

rows.grounds: state of being limited like an atom

items.question: Why are those manifold details not elaborated by the authors here?
premises: The subject is not a manifold elaboration.
Elaboration would be inappropriate due to its limited atomic character.
The authors choose not to expand it.
items.inference: Because of its atomic limitedness and non-manifold nature, those details are not elaborated by us.
uncertainties: The exact referent of te is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Because of its atomic limitedness and because it is not manifold, those matters have not been elaborated by us.

rows.grounds: purpose of attaining fulfillment in bliss
demonstrative referring to the teaching or state

items.question: What purpose should this teaching serve for the seeker of fulfillment?
premises: Own bliss has a nectar-like essence.
Satisfaction in that essence is a desirable goal.
The teaching is offered for that fulfillment.
items.inference: May this be for satisfaction in the nectar-essence of one's own bliss.
items.plain_english: May that be for satisfaction in the nectar-essence of one's own bliss.

rows.grounds: we extend or unfold in teaching

items.question: What sequence grounded in own nature do the authors now expound?
premises: Creation, maintenance, and dissolution form a sequence.
This sequence is established in own nature.
The authors undertake to expound it.
items.inference: We expound the sequence of creation, maintenance, and dissolution established in own nature.
items.plain_english: We expound the sequence of creation, maintenance, and dissolution, established in its own nature.

rows.grounds: that which dispels or splits apart

items.question: What manifestation breaks all doubts through the culminations of the group sequence?
premises: The group sequence has culminating points.
Something manifests through these culminations.
This manifestation dispels all doubts.
items.inference: Manifested through the ends of the group sequence, it is the breaker of all doubts.
uncertainties: The subject of sphuritaḥ is implied from context.
items.plain_english: Manifested through the culminations of the group sequence, it breaks all doubts.

rows.grounds: complete understanding of the self's nature

items.question: What effect does full knowledge of the self's nature have for others?
premises: Full knowledge of the self's nature can arise.
Such knowledge is not merely private.
It has the power to bestow grace on others.
items.inference: In the full knowledge of the self's nature, it bestows grace on others.
uncertainties: The feminine subject is supplied from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: In the full knowledge of the nature of the self, it bestows grace on others.

rows.grounds: affected by latent impressions of conceptual thought

items.question: How does worship proceed when pierced by conceptual latencies?
premises: Conceptual latencies can affect the practitioner.
Worship has an essential nature.
That nature continues to operate even under conceptual influence.
items.inference: Pierced by the latencies of conceptualization, the one whose nature is worship proceeds.
items.plain_english: Pierced by the latencies of conceptualization, the one whose nature is worship proceeds.

items.question: Where does true worship abide within the non-conceptual great space?
premises: There is a non-conceptual great space.
Worship can be situated there.
In that state worship abides in reverence.
items.inference: In the non-conceptual great space, that worship indeed abides in reverence.
items.plain_english: In the non-conceptual great space, that worship indeed abides in reverence.

rows.grounds: when the limiting phase of contraction dissolves

items.question: What kind of worship arises when the phase of own contraction dissolves?
premises: Own contraction has a limiting phase.
That phase can dissolve.
Worship in that dissolution is non-conceptual.
items.inference: In the dissolution of the phase of one's own contraction, worship is indeed non-conceptual.
items.plain_english: When the phase of one's own contraction dissolves, worship is indeed non-conceptual.

items.question: In what fivefold form is the nature of worship established?
premises: Worship has an essential nature.
This nature is established in a specific form.
That form is fivefold beginning with the womb.
items.inference: Because it is situated in the fivefold form beginning with the womb, its nature is worship.
items.plain_english: Because it is situated in the fivefold form beginning with the womb, its nature is worship.

rows.grounds: essential nature of the great womb

items.question: How is the nature of the great womb declared in its feminine aspect?
premises: The great womb has an essential nature.
This nature can be described by a particular state.
It is declared as the state of being female.
items.inference: The nature of the great womb is declared by the state of being female.
uncertainties: The term pikā is read as a feminine designation in this context.
items.plain_english: Of the nature of the great womb, it is declared as the feminine state.

rows.grounds: through the ordered process of reversion
assuming the form of the state of own nature

items.question: What form is assumed again through the sequence of turning back?
premises: There is a sequence of turning back.
Through this sequence a form is assumed again.
That form is the state of own nature.
items.inference: By the sequence of turning back, it again assumes the form of the state of own nature.
items.plain_english: By the sequence of turning back, it again takes the form of the state of its own nature.

items.question: How is the state of having attained own repose declared?
premises: One can attain one's own repose.
This attained state is given a designation.
It is declared as the state of the divine womb.
items.inference: Having attained its own repose, it is declared as the state of the divine womb.
items.plain_english: Having attained its own repose, it is declared as the divine womb.

rows.grounds: demonstrative referring to the prior state

items.question: What is the nature of the arising of worship in non-conceptuality?
premises: Worship has an arising.
This arising can take the form of non-conceptuality.
In that form it is of the nature of emanation.
items.inference: That arising of worship, in the form of non-conceptuality, is of the nature of emanation.
items.plain_english: That arising of worship, in the form of non-conceptuality, is of the nature of emanation.

items.question: Why is the sequence of worship characterized as maintenance?
premises: The arising of worship has a certain nature.
The sequence of worship shares that nature.
Sharing that nature makes it maintenance.
items.inference: Therefore, by being of that nature, the sequence of worship is of the nature of maintenance.
items.plain_english: Therefore, by being of that nature, the sequence of worship is of the nature of maintenance.

rows.grounds: having the essential nature of the five ethers
made of the state of being without covering

items.question: What characterizes the nature of the five ethers in this context?
premises: There is a nature of the five ethers.
This nature can be described by its quality.
Its quality is unveiledness.
items.inference: The nature of the five ethers consists of unveiledness.
uncertainties: The subject qualified by this description is supplied from context.
items.plain_english: Of the nature of the five ethers, it consists of unveiledness.

rows.grounds: having the form of the sky-moving and earth-moving powers

items.question: How is the form of khecarī and bhūcarī declared in relation to Kūrmanātha?
premises: A form identified as khecarī and bhūcarī is recognized.
This form is associated with a specific lordship.
It is declared by the state of Kūrmanātha.
items.inference: The form of khecarī and bhūcarī is declared by the state of Kūrmanātha.
items.plain_english: The form of khecarī and bhūcarī is declared as the state of Kūrmanātha.

rows.grounds: having the form that consumes dissolution

items.question: How is the form that devours dissolution declared in relation to Meṣanātha?
premises: A form that devours dissolution is recognized.
This form is associated with a specific lordship.
It is declared by the state of Meṣanātha.
items.inference: The form of the devourer of dissolution is declared by the state of Meṣanātha.
items.plain_english: The form of the devourer of dissolution is declared as the state of Meṣanātha.

rows.grounds: having the form of Raudra and Raudreśvarī

items.question: How is the form of Raudra and Raudreśvarī declared in relation to Chanda?
premises: A form identified as Raudra and Raudreśvarī is recognized.
This form is associated with a specific lordship.
It is declared by the state of venerable Chanda.
items.inference: The form of Raudra and Raudreśvarī is declared by the state of venerable Chanda.
items.plain_english: The form of Raudra and Raudreśvarī is declared as the state of venerable Chanda.

rows.grounds: pervaded by a form not seen
group of five starting with Vyomeśvarī

items.question: What pentad is entered by an unseen form in this sequence?
premises: There is a pentad beginning with Vyomeśvarī.
This pentad can be entered or pervaded.
It is entered by an unseen form.
items.inference: The pentad beginning with Vyomeśvarī is entered by an unseen form.
items.plain_english: The pentad beginning with Vyomeśvarī is entered by an unseen form.

rows.grounds: through the unfolding of its own freedom

items.question: How is the form of deities attained through own sovereignty?
premises: Own sovereignty can expand.
This expansion enables attainment of a form.
The attained form is that of deities.
items.inference: Having attained the form of deities, it does so by the expansion of its own sovereignty.
items.plain_english: Having attained the form of deities, through the expansion of its own sovereignty.

rows.grounds: starting from intellect and related principles

items.question: What principal sequence of worship constitutes dissolution beginning with intellect?
premises: Dissolution can begin with intellect and related principles.
This dissolution is identified as a sequence of worship.
That sequence is principal.
items.inference: This dissolution, beginning with intellect and so forth, is the principal sequence of worship.
items.plain_english: This dissolution, beginning with intellect and so forth, is the principal sequence of worship.

rows.grounds: of those whose essential nature is worship

items.question: What is the character of this sequence for forms whose nature is worship?
premises: There are forms whose nature is worship.
A sequence pertains to these forms.
This sequence is non-conceptual.
items.inference: This sequence of the forms whose nature is worship is non-conceptual.
items.plain_english: This sequence of those whose essential nature is worship is non-conceptual.
